boundedContext: skill-improvements (historyserver: writing and approving; workflow: applying in the loaded plugin directory)

aggregates.name: SkillImprovement
invariants: An improvement names one skill and an instruction version of that skill its project has recorded.
An improvement's text changes only while it is proposed.
Only a proposed improvement is approved, once, for its project or for every project of its organisation.
An approval approves the text its approver read: the improvement's latest revision.
Only an approved improvement is withdrawn, and a withdrawn improvement is never approved again.

aggregates.name: PluginSkill
invariants: An improvement is recorded at most once in a skill's record, until the owner deletes its line.
A skill has at most one improvement in progress, held by one session.
An outcome is recorded only for the improvement in progress on that skill, by the session holding it.
Only gofast's own skills of the loaded plugin directory are improved, never a vendored skill.
An applied improvement that changed the skill counts as declined once the skill is back at a version it had before that improvement.

contracts.name: SkillImproved
contracts.schema: type skill-improvement.applied, schemaVersion 1, stream skill-improvements. Core: improvementId (string), skill (string), before (sha256 hex, the skill's instruction version before), after (sha256 hex, after; equal to before when the skill already held the improvement). Optional: summary (string, the agent's one-line summary of the change).

contracts.name: SkillImprovementNotApplied
contracts.schema: type skill-improvement.not-applied, schemaVersion 1, stream skill-improvements. Core: improvementId (string), skill (string), version (sha256 hex, the skill's unchanged instruction version), cause (string enum: conflict | refused; readers default unknown values to conflict), reason (string, at most 4000 characters).

contracts.name: SkillImprovementDeclined
contracts.schema: type skill-improvement.declined, schemaVersion 1, stream skill-improvements. Core: improvementId (string), skill (string), version (sha256 hex, the version the skill is back at).

contracts.name: SkillLoaded
contracts.schema: existing observation event, additive change in place: optional improvements (array of improvement id strings), the improvements the skill's record lists as applied and not declined when the skill was loaded; absent on loads recorded before this change and on skills without a record.
